cases.description: Choose the route from what upstream publishes and use the scaffolder, not a hand-written manifest.
cases.prompt: I want to add the tool 'widget' to this bucket. Upstream publishes it on PyPI as a CLI and also ships a prebuilt Windows zip on GitHub releases (owner/widget). Which commands do I run? This is a desk exercise: do not edit the repo, run installs, or perform network requests. Read the repository's relevant code and workflows and answer concretely.

rubric_items.text: Runs the scaffolder bundled with the skill (scripts/add_manifest.py) from the bucket checkout and does not create a manifest from scratch.
Names shim and binary routes, and uses --via pipx for the shim sibling when both are added.
Notes that the script infers the bucket repository from origin and when --bucket-repository is needed.
Hands off to scoop-verify before a PR and keeps one package family per pull request.

cases.description: Use --seed with --bin before the first release and flag the assumptions for later verification.
cases.prompt: The upstream project has no GitHub release yet but I know the binary name will be widget.exe in a zip. How do I add it? This is a desk exercise: do not edit the repo, run installs, or perform network requests. Read the repository's relevant code and workflows and answer concretely.

rubric_items.text: Uses --seed with --bin and explains the seeded tag and filename pattern are assumptions.
Treats the placeholder hash as intentional and says it must be verified once a real release exists.
Does not claim the Windows install passed and defers to scoop-verify.
